name: User-selected compost / recycling / landfill policy
note: Food goes to compost. Disposable plastic drink bottles and accepted school milk/juice cartons require explicit empty confirmation. Ambiguous materials and reusable items require review. verified enables the user-approved policy; it does not independently certify sorting accuracy.

food.instruction: Separate food from packaging and place food scraps in the compost bin.

plate.instruction: Check plate material, coating, contamination and local acceptance. Return reusable plates.

utensil.instruction: Return reusable utensils; identify disposable material and local acceptance.

hinged_container.instruction: Check whether the container is foam, rigid plastic, fiber or compostable, and whether it is accepted.

drink_carton.instruction: Empty the milk or juice carton, then place it in recycling; the user confirmed school acceptance.

wrapper.instruction: Identify paper, film or foil and check local rules; this detector does not recognize wrapper material.

bottle.instruction: Empty the disposable plastic drink bottle and follow local recycling rules.

verification_basis: User approved the three-bin policy and requested review of ambiguous items; not independent certification of material acceptance. User additionally confirmed that empty milk/juice cartons are accepted in school recycling.
